producedBy.independence: packages/astrodynamics and packages/simulation not read and not run (ADR-003); references import nothing from the engine.
producedBy.numberFormat: Every number is the shortest decimal that round-trips to the binary64 value; JSON.parse restores the exact binary64. Signs of zero are not preserved (−0 written as 0) except where a value is encoded as {"$number": "-0"}.

method.rule: Exact (Object.is per component) at every t_s present bit-identically in all runs, including the maneuver event fields, as instructed for ML-TASK-018 part C under open item O-4 (tolerances.md §1, §7 VT-09).

tolerance.vt09: exact (Object.is) — conditional on O-4 (a sample is a function of segment initial state, segment start time, t_s and constants only); the fallback tolerance of §7 VT-09 is not used here
tolerance.vt10: exact: repeated runs of one request bit-identical in every field, including typed-array contents and requestId
